en: Colorized postcard view of a stone and concrete bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches and piers reflected in the water. Behind the bridge rises a steep, wooded hill topped by a white medieval castle complex with green roofs. The sky is clear blue. Printed captions in German identify the scene as being in Leisnig and show Schloss Mildenstein with the Fischendorfer Brücke.
